title: Machine learning on serum mass spectra and AFP detects hepatocellular carcinoma
summary: Serum from three cohorts was split into development, internal validation and independent validation sets; Deep MALDI mass spectra were fed to the VeriStrat classification algorithm together with AFP, and machine learning classified samples as cancer or no cancer. Sensitivity and specificity were both above 80% for HCC, with improved detection over AFP for all tumor sizes, especially small lesions. Specificity did not depend on cause or severity of underlying disease. The independent validation set was small, and the authors call for a prospective study.
